cases.sentence: Когда кто-то приносит в жертву примирения животное из крупного скота, он должен поставить его перед ___
cases.translation: When anyone brings an offering of peace to the Lord from the herd, he shall present it before the Lord
cases.explain: The preposition 'перед' (before) takes the instrumental case to indicate something presented in the sight of someone.

cases.sentence: Пусть он положит руку на голову ___
cases.translation: He shall lay his hand on the head of the offering
cases.explain: The preposition 'на' (on) with the genitive case indicates possession (the head of the offering).

cases.sentence: Затем священники, сыновья Аарона, окропят кровью ___
cases.translation: Then Aaron's sons, the priests, shall sprinkle the blood on the altar
cases.explain: The transitive verb 'to sprinkle' governs the accusative case for the direct object (the altar).

cases.sentence: Пусть он принесет из жертвы примирения в огненную жертву весь жир, покрывающий ___
cases.translation: He shall offer the fat that covers the innards
cases.explain: The present participle 'covering' takes the accusative case for what it covers.

cases.sentence: Все это он вынет вместе с ___
cases.translation: He shall remove all this together with the kidneys
cases.explain: The preposition 'с' (with) takes the instrumental case to indicate what is taken along with something.

cases.sentence: Пусть сыновья Аарона сожгут это на жертвеннике на ___
cases.translation: Aaron's sons shall burn it on the altar on the burning wood
cases.explain: The preposition 'на' (on) with the prepositional case indicates location on something burning.

cases.sentence: Если он приносит Господу в жертву примирение животное из мелкого ___
cases.translation: If his offering for a sacrifice of peace offerings is from the flock
cases.explain: The preposition 'из' (from) takes the genitive case to indicate the source or category.

cases.translation: All the fat belongs to the Lord
cases.explain: The verb 'to belong' (принадлежит + dative) indicates possession with the dative case.

reading.ru: Когда кто-то приносит в жертву примирения животное из крупного скота, все равно, самца или самку, он должен поставить перед Господом животное без изъяна.
reading.question: What kind of animal could be used for a peace offering?
options: Only a male lamb from the flock
Either a male or female from the herd, without defect
reading.correct: Either a male or female from the herd, without defect
reading.explain: The text specifies that either male or female animals from the herd could be brought, but must be without defect.

reading.ru: Пусть он положит руку на голову жертвы и заколет ее у входа в шатер собрания.
reading.question: What was the person to do after laying his hand on the animal?
options: Kill it at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting
Offer it whole to the priests
reading.correct: Kill it at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting
reading.explain: The text states that after laying his hand on the offering, he was to kill it at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

reading.ru: Затем священники, сыновья Аарона, окропят кровью жертвенник со всех сторон.
reading.question: What did the priests do with the blood of the offering?
options: Poured it out at the base of the altar
Sprinkled it all around the altar on every side
Applied it to their own garments
reading.correct: Sprinkled it all around the altar on every side
reading.explain: The text explicitly states that the priests sprinkled the blood on the altar from all sides.

reading.ru: Пусть он принесет из жертвы примирения в огненную жертву Господу весь жир, покрывающий внутренности или прилегающий к ним, обе почки с жиром.
reading.question: What parts of the animal were to be offered as a fire offering?
options: The meat and skin of the animal
All the blood and internal organs
The fat covering the innards, both kidneys with their fat
reading.correct: The fat covering the innards, both kidneys with their fat
reading.explain: The text describes specifically which fatty parts should be offered to the Lord as a fire offering.

reading.ru: Пусть сыновья Аарона сожгут это на жертвеннике, на горящих дровах вместе с жертвой всесожжения.
reading.question: Where were the fatty portions to be burned?
options: In a fire outside the camp
In a special furnace in the priesthood's house
On the altar with the burning wood together with the burnt offering
In the courtyard of the congregation
reading.correct: On the altar with the burning wood together with the burnt offering
reading.explain: The text specifies that Aaron's sons were to burn these portions on the altar on the burning wood with the burnt offering.

reading.ru: Это будет огненная жертва, благоухание, приятное Господу.
reading.question: What was the purpose of offering the fat portions to the Lord?
options: To provide food for the community meal
It would be a fire offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord
To fulfill the needs of the sanctuary
reading.correct: It would be a fire offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord
reading.explain: The text states the purpose: the offering would be a fire offering with an aroma pleasing to the Lord.
